reason: B opens with a dramatized scene — the water-clock, the bronze disks, Socrates' bare feet and the narrow 280-221 vote — which pulls a general reader in immediately, then keeps varying its material (Catalhoyuk houses, Talheim, Jebel Sahaba, the Old Bailey) so each section brings a new setting rather than another gloss on the same one. A leans on abstract framing sentences and circles back to Chicago and the Twelve Tables repeatedly, restating the same caution about sources and categories in several paragraphs. B's definitions arrive compactly between concrete cases, giving a stronger sense of forward movement; A's read as an essay that keeps clearing its throat.
